column5: READ LIVE AS A NODE 2026-09-22 with get_metadata - the read this row has been carried without since 2026-09-14 - and the carried geometry CONFIRMS child for child, then CLOSES. THE GEOMETRY: the frame is 1440x3294; `Frame 520` 9691:11232 is 1318 at (32,24), the 32 being the centring residue of the 1318 cap inside main (1382-1318)/2 and not a gutter spec; `Frame 658` 9691:11283 is 1318x621 at (0,0); and its two children sit FLUSH - the bet panel `Frame 1000004044` 9691:11284 is 356x621 at x=0 and the board `Starting` 9798:13101 is 954x621 at x=364. 364 = 356 + 8 and 364 + 954 = 1318, so the seam is 8, neither column is inset, and the block draws the whole column. THE GAP THIS ROW HAS CARRIED SINCE WAVE 56 IS CLOSED, and it closed because the OTHER half moved first. The wave-59 row recorded two 32s of padding Frame 658 does not draw - one GameShell's, one the widget's - and said dropping the widget's alone would land the board at 922, which matches no board, so it was deliberately NOT half-fixed. GameShell's half was then removed by a sibling lane at skai-gaming c5e7b1a4 (it pads only the vertical axis now; its own docblock names the same 922-for-954). That left the widget's 32 as the WHOLE remaining gap, and it is this lane's file. BUILT: the horizontal padding comes off the route content box (skai-gaming 004c617c, corrected to every rung at 778edf4e), which puts the row at the full 1318 and the board at 1318 - 356 - 8 = 954.000000, the frame's figure exactly. The vertical 12/16 is untouched, deliberately: every *PageSections.tsx cancels GameShell's vertical step with a matching negative margin and its docblock states that moving one without the other moves nothing. ★★ ONE THING I GOT WRONG MID-PASS AND CORRECTED BY READING, recorded because the next lane will reach for the same wrong box: I first derived the 1318 from PLAY_PAGE_COLUMN_CLASS and wrote the fix as `lg:px-0`, believing RoutedGamePage wrapped the widget in the page gutter. IT DOES NOT - RoutedGamePage.tsx:119-128 wraps only the TITLE ROW in PLAY_PAGE_GUTTER_CLASS and renders `children()` at :130 OUTSIDE it, so the page gutter is not in this chain at all and the widget's 1318 comes from GameShell's own panel cap (`max-w-[1318px]`, GameShell.tsx:121). Both boxes are 1318, so the wrong box gave the right number today and the oracle would have kept agreeing with itself if GameShell's cap ever moved. The test now reads the cap off GameShell.tsx. VERIFIED AT HEAD BEFORE BUILDING, not assumed: GameShell's fullscreen wrapper is `flex w-full justify-center p-0 md:py-4`, no horizontal padding; the row arm is `flex-col gap-2 lg:h-full lg:flex-row`; the panel arm `w-full order-2 lg:order-1 lg:w-[356px]`; the board column `flex-1 min-w-0 flex flex-col`, so the board is the remainder and the content box's own padding was the only term left. THE TEST THAT CERTIFIED THE OLD BEHAVIOUR WAS HUNTED AND FIXED rather than left green: bingoGameRowSeam.test.ts carried a docblock asserting "the board still does not reach 954 ... the row is 1254 and the board lands at 890", true when written and false after c5e7b1a4 - the shape the wave rules name as worse than a red test. It now DERIVES the width from the shipped tokens (`boardWidthAtLg()`) and fails on the NUMBER, not a class list. MUTATION CONTROL RUN IN-PROCESS, NOT IN THE TREE: feeding the resolver the pre-fix `p-3 sm:p-4` reproduces 922 and a NEGATIVE CONTROL pins it, because this checkout is shared with ~30 lanes and a defect planted in it even briefly is read by every peer's instrument as a real one (slip #554). The cascade resolver is unit-tested both ways, including that a rung ABOVE the one asked for cannot answer for it. Bingo draws no 768 board (bingo.titles.tsv carries the 1440 and the 375 cut only), so the tablet rung is n-a rather than unmeasured. 84 tests green across the 6 bingo suites, plus fairnessSubBar375 74 green; scoped tsc with both touched files proved in-program via --listFiles, 0 errors in the test file and BingoGame's 4 pre-existing (3 vite asset TS2307 at :47/:48/:56, one TS2554 at :1313) all outside my hunks. Second witness modules/skai-gaming/src/pages/play/RoutedGamePage.tsx. Commit on skai-gaming main, not pushed - Ruling 16; done here means landed, not live. No browser ran.

EACH CHILD INSETS ITS OWN CONTENT BY 16 AND THE BLOCK INSETS NOTHING, which is the distinction the earlier readings did not separate: inside the board, `Frame 1000004219` 9799:14906 is 343 at (16,12); inside the panel, every child sits at x=16 on a 343 column (CTA 9691:12047 343x52 at y=12, Frame 1000004020 343x84 at y=80, Frame 1000003954 343x60 at y=180, Frame 1000004080 343x42 at y=256, Frame 1000004019 343x42 at y=314). WHAT WAS BUILT (skai-gaming 778edf4e): the widget's route content box paid `p-3` - 12 a side - on top of those insets, which held the block at 351 and its columns at 319 against the frame's 375 and 343. That padding is off at every rung now, so the block runs the frame's full 375 and the columns land on 343. The 351 is not a new number: GameShell's own docblock records four game lanes measuring exactly that inset independently on 2026-09-14, and this is the last copy of it in bingo's chain. ⛔ THE PAGE GUTTER IS NOT INVOLVED and an earlier draft of this row said it was: RoutedGamePage wraps only the title row in PLAY_PAGE_GUTTER_CLASS and renders the widget outside it. Corrected by reading RoutedGamePage.tsx:119-130, not by inference.
